grid='''00000000000222220000
02222222220020002000
02000000020202020000
02000000020200020000
02000000020222220000
02000200020000000000
02000000020000000000
02000000020002222200
02000000020002000200
02222222220002020200
00000000000002000200
00000000000002222200
00000222222200000000
00000200000200000000
00000200000200000000
00000200200200000000
00000200000200000000
00000200000200000000
00000222222200000000
00000000000000000000'''.split()
g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in grid]
# component analysis for zeros enclosed by 2; inspect cavity sizes
R=C=20; seen=set()
from collections import deque
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if g[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in seen:
   q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; border=False
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft(); comp.append((x,y)); border|=x in [0,R-1] or y in [0,C-1]

   if not border: print('enclosed',len(comp), (min(x for x,y in comp),max(x for x,y in comp),min(y for x,y in comp),max(y for x,y in comp)))
PY"))
